notes: v1.14.584 — BACKUP HONESTY. DATA-HONESTY-COMMAND Batch 2 P0, owner GO 2026-09-09 ('GO on .584 Batch 2 P0'), the first ship adjudicated through tools/verify.ps1. ONE VISIBLE CHANGE: the backup banner under the header reports the completed op, not the tap. WHAT WAS WRONG: exportAllData() called phantomMarkBackupDone() as its FIRST line, so phantom_last_backup_ts was written and the reminder hidden before the IndexedDB read, before the share sheet, before anything could fail — a dismissed share sheet counted as a backup; both GhostEchoDB error paths built the bundle from [] and the manifest recorded the store as included:true, recordCount:0 — a failed read serialised as a clean empty store; and downloadJSON never consulted navigator.share()'s promise, so a dismissed sheet fell through to a second download prompt and nothing learned the outcome. A technician could believe they had backed up work they had not (Contract B10, B14). NOW: the banner reads 'BACKUP · SAVING…' while the read and the sheet are in flight; the backup is marked done — and a toast names the time — only when the sheet resolved ('Backup exported HH:MM') or the download was handed to the browser ('Backup file prepared HH:MM — check your downloads' — handoff rev 2: a browser download is not proof of a retained copy, so it is never called saved); a dismissed sheet or a throw is 'BACKUP NOT SAVED — … — tap to retry', persistent in the ratified fault channel (magenta #ff2bd6 — the first diff used red, which is the owner-ruled EXIT exception; caught in review) plus a toast, never marked done; a failed store read is 'PARTIAL BACKUP — review missing data: GhostEchoDB:ghosts — tap to retry', persistent in the gold channel, never marked done, with the manifest entry included:false, error:'read failed' and the bundle carrying partial:true + readFailures so the file itself says so. A second tap while saving is refused with a toast. A 15 s watchdog over the whole IndexedDB read (open and getAll, cleared by the one exit) keeps a hung request from leaving SAVING on screen and the BACKUP door dead. downloadJSON now returns a promise that always resolves with an outcome (never rejects — the unhandledrejection hook would log a ghost error for the six callers that ignore it); only the full backup passes cancelIsFinal. ⚠ LEADS, NOT FIXED HERE: the six other exports (:43292, :44038, :52420, :55130, :55146, :55202) keep the cancel-falls-through-to-download behaviour until their own honesty pass; safeGet-backed stores that fail to parse are quarantined and read back as the fallback, which the manifest still counts as included — same class, next ship. PINNED by test/e2e/51-backup-honesty.spec.js (6): not marked done until the sheet resolves; dismissed = NOT SAVED with no second download; failed read = PARTIAL with included:false and partial:true; download path marks done; a throw before the bundle is NOT SAVED and never thrown at the tap; a double tap is refused with a toast.
